SECURITY - HAZARDOUS SITUATION IN LEBANON. UK REGISTERED AIR
OPERATORS ARE RECOMMENDED NOT TO ENTER FIR BEIRUT (OLBB), EXCEPT
FOR OPERATIONS TO/FROM OLBA WHICH COMMENCE ARRIVAL AND COMPLETE
DEPARTURE OVER THE MEDITERRANEAN SEA. POTENTIAL RISK FROM
HEIGHTENED MILITARY ACTIVITY. THIS SUPERCEDES THE INFORMATION
CONTAINED IN THE UK CIVIL AIP ENR 1.1. AR-2026-3194/03.
